headlines.description: — Jaylen Brown had 30 points and 13 rebounds, Anfernee Simons scored 27 points off the bench and the Boston Celtics coasted to a 107-79 victory over the Milwaukee Bucks on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jaylen Brown has 30 points, 13 rebounds as Celtics coast to 107-79 win over Bucks

headlines.description: — Jalen Duren had 21 points and 10 rebounds after being added to the All-Star Game on Sunday night as an Eastern Conference reserve, and the Detroit Pistons routed the Brooklyn Nets 130-77 in the most-lopsided victory in franchise history.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pistons rout Nets 130-77 in most-lopsided victory in franchise history

headlines.description: — Bam Adebayo and Pelle Larsson each had 20 points, and the Miami Heat tied their third-biggest victory margin ever in a 134-91 rout of the Chicago Bulls on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Heat build 54-point lead, roll past Bulls 134-91 with Adebayo, Larsson each scoring 20

headlines.description: — RJ Barrett scored 21 points, Sandro Mamukelashvili added 20 and the Toronto Raptors beat the Utah Jazz 107-100 on Sunday night to open a five-game homestand.
headlines.shortLinkText: RJ Barrett scores 21 points in the Raptors' 107-100 victory over the Jazz

headlines.description: — Rookie Will Riley scored a season-high 18 points, including a go-ahead 3-pointer with 2:07 left, and the Washington Wizards beat the Sacramento Kings 116-112 on Sunday night in a matchup of...
headlines.shortLinkText: Rookie Will Riley scores season-high 18 as Wizards hand Kings their 9th straight loss, 116-112

events.name: Los Angeles Lakers at New York Knicks

headlines.description: — OG Anunoby scored 25 points, Landry Shamet added 23 and the New York Knicks beat the Los Angeles Lakers 112-100 on Sunday night to spoil LeBron James' 32nd game at Madison Square Garden.
headlines.shortLinkText: Knicks beat Lakers 112-100 to spoil LeBron James' 32nd regular-season game at Madison Square Garden

headlines.description: — Kawhi Leonard scored 25 points and the Los Angeles Clippers, playing without James Harden, routed the Phoenix Suns 117-93 on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Leonard scores 25 points, Clippers resume winning ways with 117-93 rout of Suns

events.name: Orlando Magic at San Antonio Spurs

headlines.description: — Victor Wembanyama had 25 points, eight rebounds and five blocks and San Antonio beat the Orlando Magic 112-103 on Sunday night in a game that started five hours late because of the Spurs' travel woes.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wembanyama fuels early surge in late start as Spurs overcome travel woes to beat Magic

events.name: Cleveland Cavaliers at Portland Trail Blazers

headlines.description: — Jarrett Allen scored a career-high 40 points and grabbed 17 rebounds as the Cleveland Cavaliers handed the Portland Trail Blazers their fifth straight loss with a 130-111 victory Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jarrett Allen scores career-high 40 points as the Cavaliers beat the Trail Blazers 130-111

events.name: Oklahoma City Thunder at Denver Nuggets

headlines.description: — Shai Gilgeous-Alexander scored 34 points and Cason Wallace added a career-best 27, including seven 3-pointers, as the Oklahoma City Thunder beat the Denver Nuggets 121-111 on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Thunder beat Nuggets 121-111 behind Gilgeous-Alexander's 34 points
